name: Mesa PanVK
author: abhay-byte
description: PanVK, the Mesa Vulkan driver for Arm Mali GPUs, on the mali_kbase kernel driver: Bifrost JM v6/v7, Valhall JM v9 and CSF v10-v14 in one universal .so, supporting v6 to v14. v15 (Mali-G2) is not fully supported. Mesa 26.3.0-devel development build (git-94af3802af). Bundled in this APK.
build: 120 (perf round 2 + sw present fix): series csf-v11 018-233 + jm-v9 + jm-v7 + jm-v7-wip 0006-0160 (prepare-rc5-tree.sh defaults; p120-final 94af3802af)
